children: GP-Act III Acquisition's net income fell year over year as trust-account interest income declined to $897.6K from $3.2M, partly offset by general and administrative expenses rising to $316.1K from $126.3K.
: The company signed an agreement to combine with Dronamics on November 3, subject to customary closing conditions.
: May's extension vote triggered redemptions of 19.8M Class A shares for approximately $215.4M.
: At September 30, the company had $193.5K in operating cash and a $2.6M working capital deficit.
: Shareholders later extended the deadline to May 8, 2027; a November vote redeemed 6.3M shares for approximately $69.5M.
